title: Ottoman Sarajevo
episode: Cities of Ottoman Bosnia with Vincent Thérouin
description: Archaeologist Vincent Thérouin on how the Ottomans built Bosnia’s towns from the 1400s around mosques, markets, and charitable foundations. In Sarajevo, the governor Gazi Husrev-beg paid for this mosque, finished in 1531, and much of the bazaar.
